Dunsky Energy + Climate Advisors (2023). Canada's Methane Abatement Opportunity: A Marginal Abatement Cost Curve for Methane Emissions in Canada's Upstream Oil & Gas Sector. Submitted to Environmental Defense Fund (Dan Grossman); with support from Alan Dunn, PEng. Montreal: Dunsky Energy + Climate Advisors. No date printed (PDF dated July 2023).

Region: Canada (Alberta, Saskatchewan, British Columbia upstream oil and gas well sites, batteries, gathering and gas plants; not oil sands mining). Locators are PDF pages, with printed page numbers in brackets where printed (Appendix B p.24-25 and the Appendix C table p.27 carry none). Loaded: per-measure capex and annual maintenance cost (Appendix C, 2022 CAD, per single-site implementation; mostly Delphi 2017 adjusted with the oil and gas PPI, plus 2023 vendor quotes for plunger lift and the casing-gas booster compressor), measure life 10 yr and discount rate 5% (p.12), abatement cost per t CO2e for each of the 33 measure-facility combinations (Appendix A), reduction % of the targeted emissions per measure-facility (Appendix B), and incremental annual LDAR survey cost per site (Appendix B/C). Costs are recorded once per measure in "Measure costs (Appendix C)" processes; per-facility processes carry only abatement cost, reduction % and (LDAR) survey cost, so capex is not repeated. Other-values: abatement cost per t CH4, programme abatement potentials, updated inventory by facility type and source with facility/well/dehydrator/compressor counts, escalation factors, LDAR cost build-up, headline results. Not loaded: MACC figures (bars), sensitivity chart (Figure 7), Figure 2/4 shares. Traps: (1) Appendix A ktCH4 table header says $/ktCH4 but values are $/t CH4 (= $/tCO2e x 25). (2) the "Bcf" table magnitudes are MMcf and its row labels disagree with the other two tables (matched by rank). (3) "Kimray To Electrical Pumps - Gas Battery" is printed twice (ranks 5 and 8); Appendix B applies Kimray to Gas Battery and Gas Gathering, so one is presumably Gas Gathering; kept as printed. (4) Abatement-cost price year not stated; 2022 assumed from Appendix C. (5) LDAR: text says 12 surveys per year, Appendix B 9 per year = surveys added to the 3/yr baseline. (6) Reduced Emissions Completions is Gas Wells in Appendix A but Gas Battery in Appendix B. (7) GWP-100 = 25 throughout. No methane avoided per device is printed, so no capacity rows. Values largely reprinted from Delphi (2017), ICF (2015), EPA Natural Gas STAR and Kemp et al. (2021).
